items.q: The size order of urinary cells written is:
items.exp: Cell size: RBC < WBC < epithelial cell. (Book p745)

items.q: Tubular epithelial cells on microscopy are described with:
opts: Clear cytoplasm and round eccentric nucleus
items.exp: Tubular epithelial cell with nucleus: granular cytoplasm & lobulated nucleus. (Book p745)

items.q: Oval fat bodies under the polarizing microscope show the:
items.exp: Polarizing microscope: Maltese cross appearance of oval fat bodies. (Book p745)

items.q: The Maltese cross in the kidney is associated with all of the following EXCEPT:
items.exp: In blood: babesiosis; in kidney: Fabry's, ADPKD, acute/chronic interstitial nephritis, prerenal azotemia. (Book p745)

items.q: Phase contrast microscopy with monomorphic red cells in the figure illustrates the category of:
items.exp: Phase contrast microscopy with monomorphic red cells corresponds to the urological pattern (vs dysmorphic/acanthocytes). (Book p745)

items.q: On the phase-contrast photo, the arrow-labelled cell larger than the surrounding red cells is a:
items.exp: The figure labels a large white cell among the monomorphic red cells (RBC < WBC < epithelial cell). (Book p745)
